correctness.rationale: Using the source embedding modulo (3n Z)^3 gives an explicit finite semidirect-product model. The center calculation reduces to fixed translations; the derived subgroup is generated by two sum-zero commutator vectors with Smith form diag(1,3); abelianization has Smith form diag(1,3,3n); the cube formula gives exponent 9n; and the Sylow centralization criterion gives the nilpotency equivalence. Each step is valid for every n>=1, including n=1.

value.rationale: Delta_n is introduced as a new infinite family of dual reflection groups. Determining its center, derived subgroup, abelianization, exponent and exact nilpotency boundary supplies basic structural invariants useful for identifying the groups, separating them from other reflection-group families, and studying their representation and grading behavior. The result is uniform in n and not a one-off computation.
